ownRead.title: Cosmological connection
ownRead.description: An open claim retained by the selected v0.2.1 companion.
ownRead.statement: **O5 — Cosmological connection.** The author’s conjecture is that continued formation of scales and organization could connect to the universe’s spatial expansion. Domain growth, increasing organizational depth, increasing accessible configurations and spacetime metric expansion are four different claims. The last is not proved by the first three. This release does not advance a new cosmological calculation or fresh observational cosmology review.
ownRead.scope: Source-reported open claim, not a demonstrated result or a required proof before publication.
ownRead.body:
## Investigate one part

The companion distinguishes growth of available states, effective degrees of freedom, changed local background and cosmological metric expansion. Identify which meaning your argument addresses before comparing it with observations or a model. Relating the first three to metric expansion is an open step, not something established by using the same word.

Bring a source passage, model, result or objection to [the contribution route](/about/#contribute). You can address this question without accepting the entire proposal. Read [all open questions](/open-problems/) for the surrounding programme.
